title: Language membership from stable reachability counts
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine deciding a language $L$ in space $sp$, and let $x$ be a bit string. For any natural number $s$ with $1\le s$, if the finite sets of configuration codes reachable from the initial configuration within the $s-1$ and $s$ work-tape windows have equal cardinality, then $x\in L$ if and only if some code reachable from the initial configuration by zero or more valid $s$-window steps encodes an accepting configuration.
hypotheses_covered: The reachable-code sets for windows $s-1$ and $s$ have equal cardinality
